conceptual_change: Introduce a volatility-gate filter to the execution engine where entry is restricted to periods where the 14-period ATR is greater than 1.5 times the 20-period moving average of ATR.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous hypothesis (BTC_1h_011) was rejected due to lack of an explicit engine implementation. This hypothesis operationalizes the volatility-gate requirement within the engine architecture to enable empirical testing.
